complete_examples.text: Vehicle-track dynamic interaction Fastener clip fatigue Random field Finite element method A B S T R A C T To investigate the vehicle-induced fatigue damage evolution of fastener clips and their impact on the vehicle-track (VT) system, a numerical dynamic model is established to achieve probabilistic evaluation.
Currently, the easiest way to achieve this is to extract the modes of the fastener clips and couple them into the vehicle-track dynamic interaction through self-programming program [4].

However, the traditional vehicle-track dynamic interaction model regards the wheelsets as rigid bodies and the high-frequency wheel-rail vibration cannot be accu-rately revealed (Xu, 2020; Zhai, 2015).
In this paper, a vehicle-track dynamic interaction model has been presented, in which the flexibility of the wheelset is taken into account by co-simulation with commercial finite element software.
